messages:
alice: Auditor Rachel asked for a very small replayable evidence bundle for the RBAC->KMS change. They want PR + approval, sanitized CloudTrail snippets for kms:Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, KMS rotation export, SIEM alert trace, and a rollback demo. Can someone own packaging?

 tom: I can. Plan: PR link + approver timestamp, jq sanitization script, Splunk saved search export, rotation CSV, manifest with SHA256, and a short playback.sh that reads sanitized JSON and prints timeline.

 auditor_rachel: Thanks  just two rules: 1) no PHI/PII or raw account IDs in artifacts; 2) include the exact commands you used for the rollback (screenshots or terminal output ok). Prefer minimal artifacts auditors can run locally.

 tom: Draft sanitization (will redact before upload):
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2024-11-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-11-11T23:59:59Z --query 'Events[].CloudTrailEvent' > raw.json
jq 'map({time:.eventTime, principal:(.userIdentity.principalId//.userIdentity.arn) | gsub("[0-9]{12}";"REDACT"), event:.eventName, key:.requestParameters.keyId})' raw.json > sanitized-kms.json
```

 alice: Add the KMS key policy export and a tiny envelope diagram. For rollback demo: show pre-change decrypt success and post-change AccessDenied. Example test commands (redact ids):
```bash
# before revert
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:REDACT:key/ABCD --profile svc-role
# after revert (expect AccessDenied)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:REDACT:key/ABCD --profile svc-role
```

 devops-bot: Reminder: upload to secure evidence bucket s3://redwood-audit-evidence/INF-7800/2024-11-11 using presigned URLs (48h). Include manifest.txt with SHA256 and mapping table.

 tom: I'll assemble a compact bundle and post the presigned link here when done. ETA: EOD tomorrow. Anyone object to owners?

 auditor_rachel: Sounds good  please include a one-page runbook (README.md) with step-by-step playback instructions. We may request a 15min call to replay. Thanks :thumbsup:
